$comment: The blank starting point for config/sites.json (which is gitignored and does not
exist in a fresh clone). setup.mjs, wizard.mjs and wizard-gui.mjs all copy THIS file,
never config/sites.example.json - that file's defaults are a worked illustration
(demousr@server42...) meant for a human to read, not values a script should adopt
as if they were real. Copying the illustration here instead of genuine CHANGEME
placeholders was a real bug: a fresh clone would show the wizard's 'found existing
connection details - reuse them?' prompt against fictional data before you had
Fill in the three CHANGEME values yourself, or let a wizard do it interactively.
